name.value: Centennial Park Leisure Centre and Arena

description.value: Centennial Park Leisure Centre and Arena is a City of White Rock-operated multi-use complex featuring an ice rink, auditorium, large hall, and meeting rooms. The arena transitions to a dry-floor venue from April through August for indoor sports and community events, giving it year-round community relevance. Cyclists exploring the White Rock and South Surrey area may find it a useful urban landmark near the North Bluff Road corridor.
